scope: ss 2-10: who may make a directive (s 3), witness competence and the two-witness rule (s 3(2)-(3)), the witness's duty (s 4), the registration gate (s 5(3)), certification of terminal illness including the section 9(4) composition rule and the section 9(5)-(7) committee and presumption, and the section 10 duty to act with its exceptions, disqualifications, preconditions and the pregnancy override. NOT ENCODED: ss 11-22 (savings, offences, composition of offences, regulations), which state consequences rather than decide anything. The register, the prescribed forms, and every medical judgment are facts supplied.
